candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit threshold comparison from '>' to '>=' so equal-to-MinDeposit deposits are accepted and can change balances.
Remove the conditional guard so all payable calls increase balances (even tiny deposits), changing balances for some keys.
Invert the conditional so only deposits smaller than or equal to MinDeposit are accepted, altering which calls change balances.
Move the balance increment to occur before the require check so balances are updated even if the defensive require would have failed (changing observable balances).
Replace addition with assignment to zero so Deposit resets the caller's balance to zero when condition holds, changing balances.
